name: Noise
description: Animated film grain overlay with optional dust, hairs, scratches, scanlines and flicker. Sits on top of a section or the whole viewport without blocking clicks.
contents: Tiled grayscale or colored grain layer with jittering position
Canvas layer for dust specks, hairs and vertical scratches
behavior: Grain tile is generated once on a canvas and repositioned randomly at the set fps
Opacity flickers randomly when flicker is above 0
Dust, hairs and scratches are redrawn each frame step
Scanlines shift by one pixel step each frame
Animation pauses when offscreen and stops entirely with prefers-reduced-motion
editableByProps: Grain strength, scale, contrast, color and animation speed
Blend mode against the content below
Dust, scratches, scanlines and flicker amounts
Cover the parent or the whole viewport, stacking order and extra classes or styles

needsCodeEdit.change: Change dust and hair tones or scanline look
needsCodeEdit.where: drawSpeck, drawHair and the LINES constant

fixed: Overlay is pointer-events-none and aria-hidden, purely decorative
Non-fixed mode is absolutely positioned, so the parent needs position relative
Fixed mode covers the whole viewport
Values are clamped: opacity, flicker, dust, scratches, scanlines 0 to 1, fps 0 to 60, size minimum 0.5
Unknown blendMode falls back to normal
Grain pattern is seeded and identical every render, only its position moves
Scanlines and dust use fixed dark and warm light tones
Uses browser canvas, ResizeObserver and IntersectionObserver, client only
